240→    simp [List.flatMap_cons, requote_append, ih]

theorem amp_count_formula (cs : List Char) (q : Bool) :
    (cs.flatMap (fun c => escapeOne c q)).count '&' =
      cs.count '&' + cs.count '<' + cs.count '>'
        + (if q then cs.count '"' + cs.count '\'' else 0) := by
  induction cs with
  | nil =>
    cases q <;> simp
  | cons c cs ih =>
250→    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.count_append, ih, List.count_cons]
    by_cases hAmp : c = '&'
    · subst hAmp
      cases q <;> simp [escapeOne_count_amp] <;> omega
    · by_cases hLt : c = '<'
      · subst hLt
        cases q <;> simp [escapeOne_count_amp, hAmp] <;> omega
      · by_cases hGt : c = '>'
        · subst hGt
          cases q <;> simp [escapeOne_count_amp, hAmp, hLt] <;> omega
260→        · by_cases hQu : c = '"'
          · subst hQu
            cases q <;> simp [escapeOne_count_amp, hAmp, hLt, hGt] <;> omega
          · by_cases hAp : c = '\''
            · subst hAp
              cases q <;> simp [escapeOne_count_amp, hAmp, hLt, hGt, hQu] <;> omega
            · cases q <;> simp [escapeOne_count_amp, hAmp, hLt, hGt, hQu, hAp] <;> omega

theorem quot_count_formula (cs : List Char) (q : Bool) :
    (cs.flatMap (fun c => escapeOne c q)).count '"' =
270→      if q then 0 else cs.count '"' := by
  have hflat :
      (cs.flatMap (fun c => escapeOne c q)).count '"' =
        (cs.map (fun c => (escapeOne c q).count '"')).sum := by
    simp [List.flatMap, List.count_flatten, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
